name: Underground Funkin (Exhibition Build)
author: Ep8s
description:
This is the culmination of 2 years of work. Although the project is cancelled, I have learned from the experience and have gained a lot of knowledge on the engine. This is from when I was just starting out in game development, and I'm proud of it. Keep that in mind when playing, as the game may be buggy/janky.

Controls: D=Left F=Down J=Up K=Right
